value: Since its November 2022 launch, the AI chatbot ChatGPT has significantly impacted education, raising concerns about academic integrity. To explore this, a January 2023 survey of 1,000 U.S. 4-year college students investigated their knowledge and use of ChatGPT for schoolwork. Results show that 30% of students have used ChatGPT on written assignments, with nearly 60% of this group utilizing it for over half their work. Remarkably, 75% of ChatGPT users believe it is cheating but use it anyway. Educators are responding diversely, with 46% of students reporting bans, while others explore integrating the tool into their curricula. The findings highlight the complex challenges ChatGPT poses for academic honesty and the evolving landscape of teaching practices in higher education.
